$comment: Operating parameters of the seven intelligence engines registered in registries/intelligence-registry.json. Each objective quotes the engine's Purpose line in UCOS/PHASE-010 §5 verbatim; objectives are ratified, never inferred (Phase 010 §3.3). Autonomy is a per-context policy parameter; the declared level here is the ceiling that context policy may only lower. Envelopes are owned by the Constitutional Assembly, a different authority from the operating one (IN-A1).

Knowledge Engine.objective: Establish and maintain the platform's canonical knowledge.

Reasoning Engine.objective: Derive new knowledge and evaluate claims against it.

Discovery Engine.objective: Make every artifact findable by intent rather than by address.

Classification Engine.objective: Place entities under the right taxa, automatically.

Recommendation Engine.objective: Propose preferred states and artifacts for a purpose in a context.

Optimization Engine.objective: Select configurations or actions that best satisfy a stated objective under constraints.

Autonomous Governance Engine.objective: Apply ratified governance continuously, without human intervention in each application — and remain accountable for every application.
